name: ctxjev-plugins
description: ctxjev: hands the highest-scoring context back after Claude Code compacts a session. Scores offline by default and sends nothing; no configuration required to start. Its effect on held-out tasks hasn't been shown.

plugins.name: ctxjev
plugins.description: Scores your session's context right before Claude Code compacts it (offline by keyword overlap by default; Jev if you opt in), then hands the highest-scoring entries back as a reminder the instant compaction finishes — so the detail that mattered most doesn't have to survive being summarized to still be there. Works automatically; /ctxjev:set-goal aims it at something specific, /ctxjev:status shows what's cached.
